task.title: Host execution is granted by default: with neither the global nor the project co

acceptance.statement: Host execution is granted by default: with neither the global nor the project configuration specifying `hostExecution.allow`, both `devcontainer_host_exec` and `/devcontainer host-exec` are permitted. The default is expressible in code (not duplicated as a literal) and is covered by tests that build the effective config from an empty global and an empty project file.

Withholding still wins, and nothing can widen beyond a deny: a project file that sets `hostExecution.allow: false` withholds host execution regardless of the default, and a global file that sets `false` withholds it even when the project sets `true`. No other configuration semantic changes — `destructive.allowStop`/`allowRemove` stay fail-closed, and `routeMode`, `activation`, the timeout/output ceilings and the discovery limits keep their current defaults (covered by tests).

The governed properties of the host surface are unchanged by the default flip: every host run is still audited under `operation: "host-exec"` with `initiator: "host-escape"` and the configured capture mode, argv is still transported literally (no shell), `/devcontainer setup` is still ungated by `hostExecution.allow`, and `stop`/`remove` still require both the policy grant and a fresh per-action confirmation token.

The denial messages describe the CURRENT policy truth instead of a stale remedy: when host execution is refused, the typed error and the command text say that a configuration is withholding it and which layer can (project or global), and no message still instructs the operator to set `hostExecution.allow=true` globally when the default already grants it. Covered by tests on both surfaces.

Documentation matches the new posture: `README.md` and `README.zh-CN.md`, `docs/configuration.md`, `docs/security.md` and `SECURITY.md` state the grant-by-default plus the withhold rules, `CHANGELOG.md` records it as an explicitly called-out behaviour change for existing installs (an operator who relied on deny-by-default must now set `false`), and `docs/troubleshooting.md` gains a "host-exec is denied by policy" entry naming the two files to check, the merge rule, and the `/reload` needed after a configuration change.

No regression: the full gate set stays green — `npm run typecheck`, the unit suite (including the updated default-config assertions), `node scripts/verify-package.mjs --unit-tests`, a rebuilt `dist/` that matches a fresh build, the packed `smoke-pi-package.mjs --no-model`, and `npm run install:local -- --check`.
